changed: Device Sync sends much less when nothing has changed. A sync with nothing new to share no longer re-checks every record with the sync server or re-sends this device's list of records, which also spares your other devices from downloading that list again. At least every 12 hours a device that's in use still sends it in full, so your other devices keep seeing when it last shared changes.

Device Sync no longer downloads again records this device already has but doesn't share: imported dances that **Skip unused imported dances** keeps back, and records you've deleted whose deletion hasn't reached your other devices yet.
data_migrations: The library's database moves to a new version that remembers what this device last shared with Device Sync. Nothing in your library changes.

added: Schema v40: nullable `baseline_state.published_manifest_hash` and `baseline_state.published_verified_at`, with `SyncLocalRepository.publishedManifest` and `setPublishedManifest` (`SyncPublishedManifest`).
